matches.rationale: GT-1 concerns the contradictory definition of threshold γ between Section 3.3 (filtering logic) and Appendix C.2 (experimental interpretation). None of the findings address γ, the feature fusion threshold, or the filtering/acceptance mechanism; all three findings focus on entirely different issues (complexity claims and softmax formulation).

GT-2 concerns the undefined symbol k in rank_x^k(C) and the inconsistent definition of the reciprocal rank fusion formula in Equation 3. None of the findings discuss Equation 3, the RRF formula, the rank notation, or the smoothing constant d; all findings address different mathematical issues.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Identifies a genuine complexity claim inconsistency between Abstract and §3.1/Appendix A.1, but this defect is not in the ground truth.
Reports the same O(log N) vs. O(log N + k|V|²) complexity inconsistency as pred_id 1, just from a different location in the paper.
Correctly identifies that Equation 9's softmax is applied to a scalar rather than a vector, a genuine mathematical error not in the ground truth.
